sources.title: Jinli Ancient Street in Chengdu: Is It Worth Visiting? - China Highlights
sources.content:
Jinli Ancient Street is described as one of the world's 21 most beautiful streets, named by CNN. Located in Wuhou District, approximately 20 minutes from downtown Chengdu, this pedestrian-only street features traditional architecture and cultural attractions.

Hours & Access: The street remains open throughout the day, with shops operating from 8:30 AM to 10 PM. Visitors can reach it via Metro Line 3, exiting at Gaoshengqiao Station (Exit C), followed by a 10-15 minute walk.

Best Times to Visit:
- Evening (8-10 PM): Most beautiful when red lanterns illuminate the street
- Morning (9-11 AM): Fewer crowds during weekday visits
- Spring Festival: Features lantern shows and temple fairs, though entry fees apply

Activities & Attractions:
Photography Opportunities: Top photo spots include the entrance gate plaque, Huanglong Pond with its stone arch bridge, Fushou Alley with red lantern coverage, and the Old Stage featuring an ancient tree and tea houses.

Food Experiences: Local snacks range from ¥10-30, including Ye Popo Boboji (spicy chicken skewers), Zhang Fei Beef, Juntun Guokui (crispy flatbread), and San Da Pao (sticky rice balls).

Cultural Activities: Visitors can enjoy Sichuan Opera performances including face-changing shows, watch artisans create sugar paintings and dough figurines, or relax in tea houses (approximately ¥30 per person).

Shopping: Street vendors and curated shops sell modern souvenirs and traditional Sichuan handicrafts including shadow puppets, embroidery, and paper cutting.

Nearby Attraction: Wuhou Shrine sits adjacent to Jinli, separated by a single wall.

Visitor Recommendations: Plan hanfu (traditional dress) photoshoots around 4-5 PM for optimal lighting. The street experiences significant crowding on weekends and holidays, making weekday visits preferable.

sources.title: Jinli Ancient Street Chengdu: Travel Guide & Visit Tips
sources.content:
Jinli Ancient Street represents one of the most lively attractions in Chengdu, blending historical significance with contemporary local culture. Positioned adjacent to Wuhou Temple, it showcases Three Kingdoms heritage while offering visitors access to traditional crafts, folk performances, and leisurely teahouse experiences.

Essential Details:
Location: No. 231, Wuhouci Street, Wuhou District
Hours: Open 24/7; most vendors operate 08:00-22:00, bars stay open later
Admission: Free entry; some activities require payment
Time Required: 1-2 hours
Ideal Visit: After 18:00 for lantern displays and evening ambiance

Transportation Options:
Bus: Lines 1, 57, 77, 82 to Wuhouci stop (3-5 minute walk)
Metro: Lines 3 or 5 to Gaoshengqiao Station, exits C/D (10-minute walk)
Taxi/Rideshare: Approximately 2.2 km from Tianfu Square; 15 minutes

Recommended Walking Route: Begin at the main archway for photography, proceed to the Ancient Opera Stage for Sichuan Opera performances, visit Jiupin Snack Street for local cuisine, observe Zhuge Well's Three Kingdoms narrative, and conclude at Huanglong Pool where lantern reflections create an ideal relaxation setting.

Food Specialties: Zhang Fei Beef, Three Big Cannon, Bobo Chicken, Sugar-coated Glutinous Balls, Fat Intestine Noodles, Leaf-wrapped Sticky Rice, and Egg Pancakes. Prices tend to exceed other Chengdu locations; sampling small portions controls expenses.

Shopping & Handicrafts: Traditional Sichuan artworks available include Shu embroidery, bamboo weaving, paper-cutting, silverware, and shadow puppets. Negotiation commonly reduces prices.

Best Visiting Times: Optimal 17:00-18:00 when red lanterns are all lit up. Quieter exploration after 21:30 when crowds diminish. Avoid major holidays.

Jinli vs. Kuanzhai Alley Comparison:
Jinli: Traditional, vibrant nightlife. Classic Sichuan design with lanterns. Street snacks. Best evening/night (17:00-22:00).
Kuanzhai: Urban chic, daytime-focused. Modernized historic elements. Sit-down restaurants. Best daytime (10:00-18:00).

sources.title: Jinli Ancient Street Chengdu Guide 2026: Things to Do, Eat & See
sources.content:
Jinli Ancient Street, part of the Wuhou Shrine Museum complex, is one of China's top ten pedestrian streets. Spanning over 30,000 square meters with a street length of 550 meters, it includes three distinct areas: the Three Kingdoms Historical Relics Zone, the Jinli Folk Customs Zone, and the Western Zone.

Getting There: Board Line 3 of the Chengdu Metro, alight at Gaoshengqiao Station, take Exit A, and then a short walk to Jinli.

Cultural Experiences: Tea houses provide serene settings where masters demonstrate tea brewing. Sichuan Opera Face Changing performances are the most famous stunt. Workshops where visitors can learn Shu embroidery, pottery, and paper-cutting.

Food & Snacks: Zhang Fei Beef, Three Big Cannon (San Da Pao), Bobo Chicken, Sugar-coated Glutinous Balls, Fat Intestine Noodles, Leaf-wrapped Sticky Rice, and Egg Pancakes. Street food inside Jinli tends to be more expensive than elsewhere.

Best Time to Visit: Weekday mornings for fewer crowds. Most beautiful when lanterns light up after 8pm.

Practical Tips: Jinli Street is free to enter. Wear comfy shoes. Always inquire about prices first. Pair your visit with Wuhou Shrine for a culturally enriching day.

sources.title: 锦里 - 百度百科
sources.content:
锦里位于四川省成都市武侯区，是成都武侯祠博物馆的重要景点。占地30000余平方米，街道全长550米，采用清末民初四川民居风格建筑，融合三国文化与四川民俗文化内涵。

历史背景：锦里原为秦汉三国时期成都以织锦、售锦为主的一条古街，历代文献词赋多有记载。织锦业的发达使成都获得锦城别称。三国蜀汉时期，蜀锦占据极其重要的政治经济地位，诸葛亮甚至将其提升至战略高度。

开发历程：2004年10月正式对外开放。2009年1月锦里延伸段开放，形成水岸锦里新景观。2005年被评为全国十大城市商业步行街之一。2006年获国家文化部国家文化产业示范基地认证。2021年被CNN评为全球最美21条街道之一。2022年入选首批国家级旅游度假区。

主要景点：
锦里古街：展现明清时期民居特色，设有煮酒坊、阿斗井、诸葛井等建筑，定期上演川戏和坝坝电影。
九品小吃街：九为阳数之极，汇集张飞牛肉、肥肠粉、凉糕、叶儿粑、三大炮等特色小吃。
诸葛井：传说为诸葛亮为民谋利所挖。
古戏台：采用中国传统戏台结构，以三国故事为主题的木雕装饰，定期演出川戏经典剧目。
黄龙潭：取名东吴孙权年号，湖心亭名凤仪亭，源自《三国演义》貂蝉吕布故事。
阿斗井：相传刘禅祭祖时驻足之地。
宋代石刻长廊：展示111件宋代石刻艺术品，长约120米。
民俗记忆墙：保存川西非遗代表作品，计划于2109年开启。

文化特色：景区汇集茶楼、客栈、酒楼、戏台、工艺品和土特产。被誉为成都版清明上河图，拜武侯、泡锦里已成为成都旅游口号。

旅游信息：地址武侯祠大街231号附1号。开放时间24小时免费开放。门票免费。可乘多路公交车前往。

sources.title: How to Visit Jinli Ancient Street: Map, Food, Markets, Hotels & Tips
sources.content:
Jinli Ancient Street is one of China's top pedestrian streets located adjacent to Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu. The street is free to enter and is best visited in the evening when the red lanterns create a magical atmosphere.

The street is divided into three main zones: the historical relics area focused on Three Kingdoms culture, the folk customs area with traditional crafts and performances, and a modern zone with cafes and bars.

Practical tips: Start at Wuhou Shrine in the afternoon, then transition to Jinli for evening strolling. The street food is slightly overpriced compared to other Chengdu locations but the atmosphere makes up for it. End your day with a walk along the Jinjiang River for night views.

Combine your Jinli visit with nearby Wuhou Shrine (50 RMB admission). Both can be explored in a half-day trip.
